tagline: A little curiosity. A closer connection.
eyebrow: FOR THE PEOPLE YOU KNOW. AND THE THINGS YOU DON’T.
heroBody: Small questions can open big conversations. Nuance is a place to discover what makes you, your friends, and your favourite people wonderfully different.
note: Quizzes in English, Ukrainian and French. Group play comes in a later stage.
cardQuestion: What makes you feel most understood?
howBody: A playful way to make room for another point of view.
step1Body: Choose a topic and explore it on your own.
step2Body: Save your answers as you go. Change them before you finish.
step3Body: See a private reflection based on your own answers.
catalogBody: Browse original quizzes in English, Ukrainian and French.
privacyBody: Nuance is in development. Solo answers are private and essential cookies secure access. Guest answers and registered quiz history become inaccessible after seven days. Physical cleanup and privacy request workflows are pending; this development app is not ready for production.
footer: Made for connection. Built with care.
name: Your name
authError: We couldn’t complete that request. Check your details or try again later.
sent: If this address is eligible, a code has been sent. It expires in 10 minutes.
verified: Email confirmed. You can now sign in.
resetDone: Password updated. Sign in with your new password.
accountBody: Your recent reflections and private quiz drafts.
futureHistory: Completed quizzes remain accessible for seven days.
denied: You don’t have access to this area.

quiz.catalogIntro: Find a small question worth a good conversation.
quiz.startNote: Your answers and results are private. Access expires after 7 days, including registered history. Losing your guest cookie means losing access.
quiz.gateBody: You must be at least 18 to view adult quiz content. Confirm only if you are 18 or older. This development gate is a self-declaration.
quiz.error: We couldn’t complete that request. Your changes are still here; try again.
quiz.conflict: A newer revision exists in another tab. Reload to use the saved version; your unsaved changes will be discarded.
quiz.unavailable: This private quiz is unavailable or expired. Reconnect with the same session, or start a new attempt.
quiz.missing: Answer every required question before finishing.
quiz.resultNote: A summary of your answers for entertainment and conversation, not a psychological assessment or compatibility score.
quiz.high: Your scale answers average at least 4. Reflect on why these topics matter to you.
quiz.low: Your scale answers average 2 or below. Reflect on when these topics might matter more.
quiz.balanced: Your scale answers average between 2 and 4. Consider which situations would change your answers.
quiz.choices: Review the choices you selected and what they mean to you.
quiz.draftIntro: Private drafts stay private. Complete every translation before requesting moderation. Publication requires approval.
quiz.upload: Upload PNG, JPEG or WebP (max 5 MB)
quiz.validation: Check the highlighted fields, question types and selection bounds.
quiz.noHistory: No completed quizzes in the last 7 days.
quiz.previewNote: Preview only; these responses are not saved.
quiz.scaleHelp: 1 = lowest, 5 = highest; use the question’s wording for context.
